verdict.rationale: Notte's core product is natural-language task execution. The GitHub README says it gives "AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites," the site promises "Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt," and an agent-start API runs web agents "to act on your behalf." The docs also show a multi-step example: navigate to LinkedIn, log in with credentials, extract messages. One HN user reported a failed extraction on hyatt.com; that is a single anecdote, not a systematic contradiction, but it lowers confidence. missing for 10: explicit documentation of form-filling and click-through flow handling beyond the single example, independent hands-on corroboration of successful end-to-end runs.
